forms.title: Form 1040 U.S. Individual Income Tax Return — 2024 MFJ core values
forms.rationale: Computed from cited W-2 wages, Schedule E K-1 ordinary income from Whitfield Media LLC, S-corp shareholder health insurance deduction under Notice 2008-1/IRC §162(l), and §199A QBI deduction.

forms.title: Schedule 1 (Form 1040) — Additional Income and Adjustments to Income
forms.rationale: Schedule E net K-1 ordinary income of $180,000 flows to Schedule 1 line 5 and then line 10. S-corp shareholder health insurance of $14,400 is deducted on line 17 and flows to line 26.

forms.title: Schedule E (Form 1040) — Supplemental Income and Loss
forms.rationale: Whitfield Media LLC, an S corporation, reports $180,000 of ordinary business income in Box 1 of its Schedule K-1. The shareholder materially participates as the sole owner/officer, so the activity is nonpassive.

forms.title: Form 1120-S — U.S. Income Tax Return for an S Corporation — 2024 (provisional)
forms.rationale: Provisional S corporation return for Whitfield Media LLC. Ordinary business income of $180,000 is taken from the Schedule K-1. Known deductions include officer compensation ($95,000) and employer solo 401(k) contribution ($23,750). Gross receipts and other expenses are pending entity books.

forms.title: Form 8995 — Qualified Business Income Deduction — 2024 computed line values
forms.rationale: Form 8995 uses the simplified computation because 2024 MFJ taxable income before the QBI deduction ($293,400) is at or below the $383,900 threshold. The W-2 wage/UBIA limitation does not apply.

pending_forms.title: California Form 540 — California Resident Income Tax Return — 2024
pending_forms.rationale: Full-year California resident return. Federal AGI increased by California's nonconformity add-back for the federal §199A QBI deduction.

pending_forms.title: California Schedule CA (540) — California Adjustments — Residents — 2024
pending_forms.rationale: California does not conform to IRC §199A; the $36,000 federal QBI deduction is added back on Schedule CA (540), Part I, Section B, line 8z, column C.

pending_forms.title: California Schedule A (540) Itemized Deductions — 2024
pending_forms.rationale: California itemized deductions total $23,000 from charitable contributions, exceeding the MFJ standard deduction of $11,080.

pending_forms.title: California Form 8283 — Noncash Charitable Contributions — 2024
pending_forms.rationale: $15,000 appreciated stock donation requires Form 8283 Section B and a qualified appraisal.

business_obligations_note: Whitfield Media LLC is a California S corporation. California Form 100S (California S Corporation Franchise or Income Tax Return) and the $800 minimum franchise tax are likely required; this is separate from the personal return and will be queued after entity books are provided.
